In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Bayes factor approach to testing covariance parameter(s) is an attractive alternative to the likelihood ratio tests.
the proposed Bayes factors are well suited for testing covariance parameters of a multivariate normal model with a (compound symmetry) structure.
the proposed Bayes factors are a valuable tool for testing the covariance components of the compound symmetric covariance matrix.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed Bayes factors for testing covariance parameters can be used to compare different covariance models.

we propose a Bayesian approach for the analysis of covariance matrices with compound symmetry structure.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, for testing a covariance parameter of a compound symmetry covariance matrix, it suffices to consider a proper prior distribution that satisfies a positivity constraint on the parameter of interest.
, in a marginal model setting, the Bayes factor can be used to make inferences on the covariance parameters, even when they are not of interest in themselves.

, when testing a covariance structure, it is not necessary to specify a proper prior distribution on the correlation parameters, but rather a prior on the variance-covariance matrix is sufficient to ensure a proper posterior distribution and to guarantee a balanced Bayes Factor.
